// diagnostic

E0959

`{type}.{member}` has no byte fact for its declared layout guarantee (D-LAYOUT-FACTS1=B)

What

`{type}.{member}` has no byte fact for its declared layout guarantee (D-LAYOUT-FACTS1=B)

Why

The default layout leaves field order and padding to rustc; only Jet-owned physical layouts receive byte facts

Fix

Read `kind`, `target`, `guarantee`, and `source`, or add an owner-approved physical layout declaration such as `#Layout(c)`.
